title: The Awakening of the Mask of Vaṛkesh
causes: Shaashak's exile from Lothal after her father Kavik's assassination
The relic named in Kavik's stone tablets, which she reads only once he is dead
The placement of the wooden mask onto the central temple altar, triggering the ancient basalt counterweights
outcomes: The awakening of the colossal volcanic stone Golem
The folding of the Sun Plateau's battlefield into a modern tabletop 'Game of Fate'
summary: Shaasak and Asha lead an expedition to a volcanic grotto, uncovering the Mask of Vaṛkesh. The relic awakens a giant stone golem, guiding them to a hidden plateau where the physical world folds into a tabletop game of destiny.
sources: The Mask of Vaṛkesh: The Shore of Forgotten Temples
